title: Modular Layout Lattice and Visual Snapshot Guidelines for Console Component Library
creator: Ava Chen
description: Establish a density-agnostic layout lattice and a set of visual-snapshot guidelines to unify component composition across Console dashboards, rollout rails, and cost views. The goal is to provide a small set of rules and Figma primitives that designers and engineers can apply to create consistent, accessible, and testable UI surfaces that degrade gracefully across density, region, and feature toggles.
acceptance_criteria: A documented lattice spec describing spacing steps, responsive breakpoints, and token mappings (pixel + token name)
Figma library updated with lattice-based frame components (card, list-row, rail, modal) and published as a new library version
Automated visual-snapshot checklist with 6 canonical variants per component (default, compact, dense, hover, error, disabled) added to the snapshot suite
Design-to-engineer handoff checklist (naming conventions, token aliases, accessibility notes) added to the console design system confluence page
Cross-surface audit run with a report that lists 15 components with inconsistent spacing or color token usage and owners assigned
design_notes: Introduce a 6-step lattice (L0..L5) where L0=4px baseline but components can opt into half-step spacing for microcards; map each lattice step to token names: spacing.l0..spacing.l5 and density modifiers: spacing.compact.l*
Favor a gridless alignment approach for cards where content aligns to the lattice columns rather than strict 12-col grid; this reduces visual churn across dashboard widgets of varying widths

Define three density modes: comfortable (default), compact (list-heavy tables), and dense (terminal-like telemetry panes). Each component must render correctly in all three modes without layout collapse
Prefer semantic tokens for margins (stack, inset) over component-specific px values to make runtime token replacement easier in Private deployments
Visual snapshots must be produced from Figma export presets (1280 width) and from Storybook chromatic for the same variants to cross-validate render parity
decisions: Adopt lattice naming ‘l0..l5’ instead of explicit pixel names to enable future token remapping during quantized builds
Use color tokens console.bg.surface, console.border.subtle, console.text.muted for card variants — do not use hex literals in component frames
Require an accessible minimum touch target of 40px for interactive chips and rollout toggles across density modes
Snapshots for cost-cards must include a mocked cost-sparkline and a tooltip interaction state to prevent regressions in mini-cards
